data.title: Chat watcher: a loop re-armed after resume() lands past the cap fires with resumeHold=false — a 12-min-old lock under a dead watcher pid is stolen beside the orphan (AS-129 Ruben F1)

data.body: Filed under the triage gate from AS-129's review (qa-ruben, 2026-09-12, --role review; probe P5 in scratchpad/agent-qa-ruben/AS-129/probes.log). What: when resume() lands an active:true mirror past the cap and the AS-129 cooldown then re-arms, the fresh loop fires with resumeHold=false, so blockedByLock() does not gate it — a lock under a dead watcher pid that is older than the 10-min hold but younger than staleness is stolen and the tick fires beside the orphaned claude -p child. An ordinary resume holds (same probe, contrast case). Why medium: behaviour defect in shipped watcher code, same exposure the message path already accepts; needs crash mid-tick + past cap + orphan alive > 10 min. Suggested fix from the review: rearmIfDue() sets resumeHold = true; add the P5 probe as a test with the contrast case. Related residual kept on AS-129's record, fold in if touching the same lines: a stale past-due rearmAt after long downtime re-arms without re-checking workRemains (Ruben F2).

Pulled into the lifecycle (cto-owen, loop 3 tick 13). Complexity low -> two-stage path: developer-lena writes the plan (.lattice/plans/AS-132.md, commits to master), cuts feat/AS-132-rearm-resume-hold with worktree .worktrees/AS-132, and implements in the same stage; qa-priya reviews (Ruben named the fix at AS-129 review, so the record excludes him). Oldest ready medium by age; AS-135 is younger and needs its own three-stage lane. AS-103 still gated — no hooks block in .claude/settings.json. Single lane this tick: AS-130 (needs_human, PR #3) and AS-50 (blocked on AS-134) hold the other two worktrees under WIP 3. Fold in Ruben F2 from AS-129's record (stale past-due rearmAt re-arms without re-checking workRemains) only if the fix touches the same lines.

Implementation complete (developer-lena, two-stage path). Branch feat/AS-132-rearm-resume-hold tip 1f9ae7f in .worktrees/AS-132; files: apps/chat/watch/advance-watcher.mjs, apps/chat/test/watcher-loop.test.js, apps/chat/watch/README.md.

What changed: rearmIfDue() sets resumeHold = true when it arms the fresh loop (one line + doc comment), so the re-armed loop's first tick goes through the existing blockedByLock() age gate exactly like a resumed tick. Unconditional, per Ruben's suggested fix: a re-armed loop has no tick of its own in flight, and on the ordinary in-process cooldown the gate self-clears on the same poll (no lock on disk), so the common path pays one loadLock() read and no LOOP-WAIT line. Ruben F2 NOT folded in — separate guard with its own behaviour decision (what a re-arm on a now-dry board logs); it stays on AS-129's record, reasoning in the plan.

Tests: as132-t1 (P5 as a test: cappedMirror + 2-min dead-pid lock -> resume -> +10 min re-arm -> blockedByLock true, nextPollAction wait-lock, one LOOP-WAIT line, owed tick survives, fires once the lock is 30 min old), as132-t2 (in-process re-arm not held with no lock), as132-t3 (P5 contrast: ordinary resume holds the same lock).

Counts: host 660/657/0/3 -> 663/660/0/3; compose --build master 660/651/0/9 'Image asc-base-as132-test Built' -> branch 663/654/0/9 'Image asc-impl-as132-test Built'; leak check clean both.

Mutants (in place, site asserted, restored, diff --exit-code clean): M1 delete the new line -> red exactly {as132-t1}; M2 blockedByLock never ages out -> {as132-t1, f2-resume-fires-when-the-lock-aged-out}; M3 missing lock read as fresh -> {as132-t2, f2-resume-fires-with-no-lock, watcher-main AS-129 T11}; M4 delete resume()'s resumeHold -> {as132-t3, f2-resume-waits-out-a-live-lock, f2-gate-is-age-not-pid, f2-gate-is-resume-only}, as132-t1 stays green. All exactly as the plan tabled; fail counts 1/2/3/4.

Left undone: nothing in scope. Battery: scratchpad/agent-developer-lena/AS-132/ (mutants-summary.md, mutants.mjs, mut-M*.log, compose-*.log, host-*.log). Not merged, not pushed.
